articles.summary: Retailer supports local food banks across the country with a $1 million donation to Feeding America Kohl’s (NYSE: KSS) today announced a $1 million donation to Feeding America to help address food insecurity and support family health and well-being during the holiday season. This gift will directly support Feeding America partners across the country, helping local food banks stock their shelves and provide 10 million meals to families. “We are proud to partner with Feeding America this holiday season to help address food insecurity across the country," said Jennie Kent, chief legal and corporate affairs officer at Kohl’s. "By working directly with local food banks, our donation will help Feeding America provide millions of meals in communities nationwide, ensuring families have access to the food they need." articles.title: Kohl’s Helps Provide 10 Million Meals to Families Nationwide This Holiday Season

articles.summary: Funding supports 4,700 Clubs across the country, including program improvements and trauma-informed care initiatives In honor of World Mental Health Day on October 10, Kohl’s (NYSE: KSS) today announced a $1.5 million commitment to continue its national partnership with Boys Girls Clubs of America. The funding will expand trauma-informed care training across local Clubs nationwide, helping Club professionals create healthy, supportive spaces where young people can build resilience and thrive. articles.title: Kohl's Continues Partnership with Boys & Girls Clubs of America with $1.5 Million Donation to Support Youth Mental Health and Wellness Nationwide

articles.summary: Taffet, Chief Growth and Marketing Officer for The Hershey Company, brings more than 20 years of consumer brands, marketing, and strategic leadership experience Kohl’s (NYSE: KSS) today announced that Stacy Taffet has joined its Board of Directors (the "Board") as an independent director. Ms. Taffet, Chief Growth and Marketing Officer for The Hershey Company, brings more than 20 years of leadership experience at large consumer goods brands, including 15 years of progressive leadership at PepsiCo. With deep experience driving transformation strategies and growth initiatives, Ms. Taffet will add additional depth to Kohl's Board. "We are pleased to welcome Stacy to the Board," said Wendy Arlin, Board Chair. "Throughout her career, she's been instrumental in driving meaningful growth, innovation, and value creation at large, global consumer companies. articles.title: Stacy Taffet Appointed to Kohl's Board of Directors
